entries.title: Choose your dungeon party
entries.body: Invite the teammates you want for a specific dungeon run. Eligible players who accept can enter together. Automatic grouping will still be available.

entries.title: Friends and friend requests
entries.body: Send friend requests and keep a friends list. Invite a friend to a free spar that costs no stamina and no schedule slot.

entries.title: Homes and trophies
entries.body: Build a home, show off your trophies, and invite friends over as guests.

entries.title: More room in menus
entries.body: A new Settings menu lets you pin the menu and place it on the left, bottom, or right of the screen on desktop, remembered in this browser. Long menus turn into pages with Back and Next instead of long scrolling: jump to a page with the circles and choose how many rows a page shows. My gladiator and Inventory open as named sections. Wider menus are still planned. Controls stay usable on phones.

entries.title: Level and attribute caps
entries.body: The planned maximum is level 20 and 100 total base points across the five attributes. Gear and class bonuses are applied separately. Each existing character will get one optional free respec with the cap update.

entries.title: Salvage and the forge
entries.body: Turn unused gear into salvage, then use salvage and materials such as copper, iron, and gold to upgrade weapons at a forge. Recipes and material sources are still in design.

entries.title: Gear bonuses and combat balance
entries.body: Lower critical chance, add ways to raise critical damage, and give two-handed weapons a real edge over a one-handed weapon and shield. Renown weapons are checked against gold ones. Gear weight, stat bonuses, and matching-set effects are explored later.

entries.title: More strategy in fights
entries.body: Fights depend less on luck: set a battle plan before a fight, such as your stance, when to drink a potion, and whom to target.

entries.title: PvE builds and party roles
entries.body: Party roles such as tank, summoner, buffer, and ranged damage dealer, each with its own builds and abilities, plus elemental damage and defense for PvE and dungeons, and role levels that let players progress in a role.

entries.title: Tougher expeditions
entries.body: Higher-level expeditions are coming with 2.1, along with harder party challenges and The Deep, a planned solo delve. The XP bar arrives with 1.9.

entries.title: Plan several game days ahead
entries.body: Build repeating rotations across multiple game days so you can decide when to train, fight, explore, and rest. Unlock requirements are still in design.

entries.title: More life in camp
entries.body: Talking NPCs arrive in 1.9. More NPCs, a small rotating crowd behind the Arena spectators every evening, and pettable cats, dogs, rabbits, and birds are also planned.

entries.title: Events and seasonal camp themes
entries.body: Look for timed events and changes to camp for holidays such as Halloween and Christmas.

entries.title: Music and sound effects
entries.body: Adjust music and sound effects separately, with volume and mute controls for each. Settings will be remembered on each device.

entries.title: Cosmetic companions and gear looks
entries.body: Real-money purchases arrive with card and Google Pay checkout. The first items are a Supporter Banner and a pet follower. Weapon and armor dyes and skins come with 2.0 too. These are appearance items with no combat or progression bonuses.

entries.title: Showoff card
entries.body: A big, showy card you can open from a gladiator's card to show off gear, titles and achievements, and later skins and dyes. It shows nothing private, such as gold or loot.

entries.title: Crossover skins and titles
entries.body: Special events made together with other games, YouTube creators or brands: skins in their style and a title you can earn during the event. Skins change looks only, with no combat bonuses. This comes after 2.0, once skins are in the game.

entries.title: Inventory, shops and gladiator help
entries.body: Shops show goods as icons with the inventory card, and you can search and sort. Identical items stack and you choose how many to sell. Choose gear from your Worn equipment slots. Renown gets a gold laurel. Mark messages and notifications as read. See your XP bar and level-up hint, and hover or tap any stat or attribute for help.

entries.title: Names and titles
entries.body: In Settings, choose when names and titles show above gladiators in camp: Off, When zoomed in, or Always. Newly earned titles carry a small New mark in the titles menu until you have seen them.

entries.title: Talking NPCs
entries.body: Click an NPC in camp to hear a line about themselves. The Weaponsmith's and Armorer's stalls open their shops.

entries.title: Sleeping on beds
entries.body: Resting gladiators lie straight on their beds without their armor, with an eye cover and a floating ZzZ.

entries.title: Video guides in the Wiki
entries.body: Each Wiki topic gets its own short YouTube guide, shown as a card under the topic title.

entries.title: Practice fights
entries.body: Test your build against a training dummy with stats you choose, or spar a copy of any gladiator from their profile. Free: no stamina, no schedule slot, no rating.

entries.title: Buy back sold items
entries.body: Changed your mind? Buy back your last 10 gear sales until the next game day, for the price you sold them at.

entries.title: Compare stats with mine
entries.body: Press Compare with mine on another gladiator's card to see you and them side by side, with arrows for every difference and the attributes.

entries.title: A bigger, clearer Marketplace
entries.body: The Marketplace is still a list, now with big item icons and every detail on the row. The seller comes first, with their class, league and level.

entries.title: Gladiator history on every card
entries.body: Open any gladiator's card to see their Arena, tournament and expedition history. Every kept replay can be watched by anyone. Rewards and loot of other gladiators stay private.

entries.title: Tournaments look different
entries.body: Tournament fights get a gold header band, their own rows in history, and a fancier arena called League Stands, with stands in the four league colours and league banners. You can also open any league's tournament and watch its bouts, even when your gladiator is not in it.

entries.title: Daily login reward
entries.body: Claim a reward once per game day. Seven days in a row ends with a bigger prize, and a missed day starts the streak again.

entries.title: Stamina and health potions
entries.body: Stamina potions restore 30 stamina, at most 2 per game day. A health potion is drunk automatically in a fight when health falls below a level you set, and you can drink one yourself between fights.

entries.title: Harder bosses and gear you cannot buy
entries.body: Dungeon bosses become a real challenge: a full party at the dungeon level should win only about one time in four. Gear above level 10 is never sold in shops: level 12 weapons and armor, including new kinds with their own looks, drop only from dungeon bosses. Higher levels follow with 2.1.

entries.title: Three Arena bouts an evening
entries.body: Each Arena entry will get three bouts in an evening, never against the same opponent twice. You will meet fresh faces first, and NPC or bot fighters fill in when there are not enough players. Rewards are shared across the three bouts, so a full evening pays more than one bout does today.

entries.title: More leagues, and falling back
entries.body: Platinum and Diamond join between Gold and Champion. Leagues can also be lost: at the end of each season the few gladiators with the lowest win rate in a league drop one league, if they fought enough bouts. A gladiator just promoted is safe for one season. New league badges and titles are coming too.

entries.title: Bag slots and real-money shop
entries.body: Buy extra bag slots with real money, coupons, or renown. Bag slots add space only, never combat power. Optional ads are being looked at too, such as watching a short ad for a small stamina refill; nothing is decided yet.

entries.title: Send feedback
entries.body: Send bug reports and ideas from inside the game. The team reads and answers them.

entries.title: Stamina warnings
entries.body: The Schedule will warn when your gladiator will not have the stamina for a planned activity, or when a third Training in a game day becomes a Rest, and show the stamina left after each part. A notice in camp warns before the next part. If your gladiator rests instead of its plan, the Schedule, your notifications and your own results will say so and why.

entries.title: While you were away
entries.body: When you come back to the game, a summary pops up with everything your gladiators gained since your last visit: XP and levels, gold and renown, new items, and their fight, tournament and expedition results.

entries.title: Higher levels and more content
entries.body: New expeditions at levels 15, 20, 25, and 30, dungeons at levels 17, 22, and 27, drop-only gear for levels 15 to 30 with more new weapons and armor, and much more.

entries.title: Raids
entries.body: Gladiators go together on big raids, in solo and guild versions. Details are still open.

entries.title: Seasonal pass
entries.body: A seasonal pass with a free daily-reward track and cosmetic rewards is planned once payments open.
